forbidden_inference: Do not call any edge physiologically excitatory solely because its presynaptic type is predicted ACh. Do not convert prediction confidence into synapse-level certainty. Do not change relay membership or model thresholds based on downstream behavioral performance.

mandatory_sensitivity_cases.name: PFNp_b_unresolved_sign
mandatory_sensitivity_cases.reason: PFNp_b has the lowest catalog transmitter confidence (0.532) and ambiguous cross-alias metadata.
mandatory_sensitivity_cases.rule: Repeat the signed mechanistic probe with all PFNp_b presynaptic edges assigned modeled sign 0.

model_sign_policy.warning: A modeled sign is an explicit convention derived from predicted presynaptic transmitter identity, not proof of postsynaptic effect.

source.provenance_note: Predicted neurotransmitter labels are computational catalog predictions; they are not measured synapse-specific receptor physiology.

PFNp_b.note: Lowest-confidence ACh prediction in the frozen integration types; catalog AKA metadata spans PFNm/PFNp naming. Preserve as a mandatory downstream sensitivity case rather than treating this confidence as certainty.
